claims.quoted_text: This means that each switch must be flipped exactly once since there are only 6 switches.
claims.explanation: For a switch to be on at the end, it only needs to be flipped an odd number of times, not exactly once. For example, flipping the same switch three times also leaves it on. The correct lower-bound argument would use the total number of flips: with 3 flips per minute and 6 switches needing at least one flip each, at least 2 minutes are required.
